title: Women's Trial Tri Initiative: An Introduction to Triathlon
description: In this video, we'll introduce the Women's Trial Tri Initiative, a triathlon event for female participants. We'll discuss the event's format, including a 250 meter swim, 10 kilometer cycle, and 3 kilometer run.
goals: Understand the format of a triathlon event
Learn about the Women's Trial Tri Initiative
Be inspired to participate in a triathlon
skills: Knowledge of triathlon distances and components (swim, cycle, run)
Motivation to engage in a physically demanding activity
